title: jasione crispa subsp. sessiliflora
intro: Jasione crispa subsp. sessiliflora, commonly known as mountain forget-me-not, is a plant species within the family Campanulaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The health benefits of Jasione crispa subsp. sessiliflora include its ability to alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, while its therapeutic actions include decongesting the nasal passages and soothing irritated throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic effects.
